offers_products.reason: Builds and sells new single-family homes across many communities; homes are its main offering.

offers_services.reason: Home construction is sold as a finished home; mortgage and title are ancillary to home sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells new homes directly to individual home buyers and families.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are households buying homes; no meaningful organizational buyers indicated.

recurring_revenue.reason: Each home is a one-time purchase by a buyer; revenue depends on new home closings.

cyclical_demand.reason: New home purchases are easily postponed in downturns and sensitive to interest rates.

big_ticket.reason: A new home is the largest, infrequent purchase for a household.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for finished homes, not mainly staff time; construction is subcontracted.

large_customers.reason: Buyers are individual households, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Homebuilder with land and inventory but subcontracted labor, no plants or fleets; land is heavy but asset-light model.

notes: Asset-heavy is a judgment call because homebuilders hold land and home inventory.
